title: A deeper path on a Space website stays on the site instead of redirecting to Frequency

source.ref: Owner ruling 2026-10-07: 'When a user is on the website, they should never be re directed back to the main site for anything. The website is stand alone.' ADR-1723 follow-up.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-07. THE CONSEQUENCE: on a Space website (its own domain or its free subdomain) any path deeper than one page, such as a /spaces/<slug>/book link from a block the theme does not style or an old share link, redirected the visitor to the same path on frequencylocal.com. THE FIX: routeSiteHost lands a /spaces/<slug>[/<page>] path on the site's own page (root to Home, /book, /contact, an owner page) on the same host, and answers any other deeper path with not found on the site.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('lib/sites/host.ts','utf8');if(/appOrigin\(\)\}.\{pathname\}/.test(s)||!/export function sitePathForSpacePath\(/.test(s)){console.error('LIVE-836: a deeper path on a Space website still redirects the visitor to Frequency');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails on main (deep paths redirect to appOrigin); passes once this lands.
